notes.title: Full Russian voice acting
notes.content:
Sound update for Russian-speaking users.
In the game, Russian-speaking users have the opportunity to hear replicas of surrounding characters and thoughts. Each character has a unique, non-standard funny voice that adds more positive emotions during the passage of the game.
Added the sound of inflicting / receiving / blocking damage in battles.
The musical accompaniment at work as a security guard has been changed to classical performance.
Bugs fixed.
